title: Continuous Improvement & Transformation Consultant
description:

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**JOB OVERVIEW**  
This role would lead strategic and tactical initiatives related to continuous improvement and service excellence for the Global Shared services (GSS) team spread across geographies/locations. This role would own the setup of service excellence metrics, driving CI culture using innovative techniques, deployment of Lean methodologies and build process improvement capabilities within the GSS team by conducting training and facilitation sessions.

This role would enable leadership to implement site-wide CI initiatives, setting up and rolling out new frameworks, approaches and providing inputs on thought leadership.

* Support GSS extended leadership team in executing the service excellence strategy and framework
* Assist with prioritization of process improvement opportunities and ensuring clear ownership and delivery of improvements
* Collaborate with global stakeholders for implementing initiatives that drive value
* Deep dive into current business practices and processes to identify improvement opportunities
* Lead/drive improvement initiatives such as facilitating/conducting Value Stream Mapping (VSM) sessions, present and future state process design, improvement of key metrices
* Read and interpret SAP Signavio process-mining outputs like process discovery, variant analysis, bottleneck and rework identification, conformance checks, throughput and cycle-time views to baseline current state, validate VSM findings with system evidence, and size opportunities

* Work collaboratively with global teams to develop and implement ideas that drive business value
* Lead Lean initiatives to eliminate waste, standardize processes/practices, develop action plans to achieve service excellence and customer satisfaction
* Help teams in setting up and standardize operational, service owner and business outcome metrics
* Ensure improved and standardized processes are reflected as governed, published Signavio models that serve as the single source of truth for the process

* Track, validate & report cost savings post implementation of improvement initiatives, implement site-wide CI initiatives, setting up and rolling out new frameworks
Use Signavio process-mining views to evidence baseline versus post-implementation performance and confirm improvements are sustained

* Minimum Degree Requirements: Bachelors
* Minimum years of related experience required: 8

Required Professional Certifications: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt from a reputed institute like ASQ, ISI etc.

* Preferred Degree Requirements: Masters
* Preferred Major Area of Study: Shared Service Operations / Quantitative Background
* Preferred Professional Certifications: Lean Practitioner certification, SAP Signavio certification (Process Manager / Process Intelligence)
Preferred years of related experience: 10

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio and Minitab
* Experience in SharePoint
* Lean & Continuous improvement methodology & tools
* Project management principles
SAP Signavio Process Manager (expert): demonstrated hands-on process modelling in BPMN 2.0 — building and governing multi-level end-to-end process models, applying modelling standards and conventions, managing dictionary/glossary objects, versioning, review and publishing workflows, and collaboration with process owners on model sign-off

* Good Verbal & Written Communication
* Analytical thinking
* Interpersonal skills – ability to communicate effectively across all levels & in a multi-culture environment
* Ability to influence
* Problem-solving mindset
* Fast decision making
Ability to prioritize & manage time  

  

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Certified on and hands-on with continuous improvement tools, including deploying Lean methodology, conducting VSMs for medium to large projects/initiatives, change management, knowledgeable of best-in-class industry benchmarks for service performance management

description:
MEP Manager is required to manage the complete governance, planning, execution, and commissioning of all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems across the entire High Rise Luxurious Project.

  

**Project Planning & Strategy**

* Develop and own the comprehensive MEP execution plan aligned with the overall project master schedule.
* Establish MEP milestones, resource histograms, procurement schedules, and inspection test plans (ITPs).
* Lead MEP constructability reviews at design, procurement, and pre-construction stages.
* Define the MEP phasing strategy to align with the project's luxury delivery standards and client expectations.
* Conduct risk assessments for MEP scope and implement mitigation measures proactively.

**Design Management & Technical Leadership**

* Review, evaluate, and approve MEP design drawings, specifications, and BOQs prepared by consultants.
* Manage design coordination between MEP disciplines and other trades (civil, structural, architecture).
* Lead BIM/3D coordination processes to resolve inter-discipline clashes prior to construction.
* Provide technical guidance on selection of MEP systems appropriate for luxury high-rise standards (HVAC, BMS, ELV, firefighting, plumbing, electrical, lifts, etc.).
* Review and approve method statements, material submittals, and shop drawings from subcontractors.
* Advise on value engineering opportunities without compromising system performance or luxury quality.

**Procurement & Subcontract Management**

* Develop MEP procurement strategy in coordination with the procurement department.
* Evaluate technical bids, prepare technical bid analysis, and recommend award of MEP packages.
* Review and finalize MEP subcontract scopes of work (SOW), terms, and technical annexures.
* Manage subcontractor performance, adherence to scope, quality, schedule, and budget.
* Negotiate and approve variations with MEP subcontractors in coordination with commercial team.

**Construction Supervision & Quality Control**

* Oversee day-to-day installation activities of all MEP trades on site across all floors and zones.
* Ensure MEP installations comply with approved drawings, specifications, and applicable codes (IBC, NFPA, ASHRAE, IEC, local authority standards).
* Implement and enforce the project's quality management system (QMS) across all MEP activities.
* Conduct and chair regular MEP site inspections, audits, and walk-downs.
* Review and certify MEP progress for interim payment applications (IPAs) from subcontractors.
* Ensure MEP works are executed in sequence to support luxury interior finishing requirements.

**Scheduling & Progress Monitoring**

* Monitor MEP progress against the baseline schedule; identify delays and drive recovery plans.
* Prepare and present weekly and monthly MEP progress reports to senior management and client.
* Coordinate MEP programme with the project planning team (Primavera P6 / MS Project).
* Track manpower deployment, productivity benchmarks, and material deliveries against plan.
* Coordinate early MEP works (sleeves, conduits, embedded items) with civil/structural activities.

**HSE & Regulatory Compliance**

* Champion a strong safety culture across all MEP works in line with the project HSE plan.
* Ensure MEP-related Method Statements & Risk Assessments (MSRA) are in place and toolbox talks conducted.
* Liaise with local authorities and utilities (DEWA, SEWA, Civil Defense, TRA, etc.) for approvals, inspections, and connections.
* Manage all MEP NOC and permit submissions to statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations during MEP installation and commissioning.

**Testing, Commissioning & Handover**

* Develop and manage the MEP commissioning plan and schedule in coordination with the project commissioning manager.
* Oversee pre-commissioning, commissioning, integrated testing, and system performance validation.
* Manage HVAC balancing, fire alarm testing, CCTV, access control, BMS integration, and utility connections.
* Ensure preparation of O&M manuals, as-built drawings, warranties, and training documentation.
* Support the handover of MEP systems to the facility management (FM) team and client.
* Manage the MEP defects liability period (DLP) and coordinate timely close-out of snag lists.

**Cost Management & Budget Control**

* Monitor MEP expenditure against the approved budget and forecast to complete (FTC).
* Review and approve MEP variation orders in line with contractual and commercial procedures.
* Support quantity surveyors in MEP re-measurement, certification, and final account settlement.
* Identify and implement cost-saving measures without compromising quality or luxury standards.

**Stakeholder & Client Management**

* Act as the primary MEP interface with the client, employer's agent (EA), and consultant team.
* Present MEP progress, risks, and mitigation strategies to the client and steering committee.
* Coordinate MEP requirements with interior designers for luxury finishes and concealed installations.
* Manage relationships with authorities, utility providers, and third-party inspectors.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi-disciplinary MEP engineering team of engineers, coordinators, and supervisors.
* Set performance objectives, conduct appraisals, and identify training needs for MEP team members.
* Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture within the MEP division.
* Coordinate closely with project management, commercial, procurement, and QA/QC departments.

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics Engineering.
* Minimum overall 15+ years experience.
* Minimum 8-10 years experience with High Rise/ Residential projects.

  **Professional Certifications (Preferred / Advantageous)**
* PMP – Project Management Professional (PMI)
* LEED AP BD+C or BREEAM Accreditation
* ASHRAE Membership / Certification (for Mechanical background)
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) – IET, CIBSE, IMechE, or equivalent

title: Sr. System Administrator
description:
**Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure**
===================================================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.

The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Server & Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
* Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

### **Infrastructure Operations & Support**

* Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
* Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
* Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

### **Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity**

* Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
* Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

### **Projects & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
* Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

### **Stakeholder & Supplier Management**

* Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
* Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

**Essential Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
* Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
* Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
* Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
* Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

**Desirable Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* **Technical expertise:** Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
* **Problem solving:** Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
* **Teamwork:** Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
* **Resilience:** Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* Infrastructure availability and reliability.
* Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
* Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
* Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
* Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
* Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
* Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.**

You will develop the 0-24-month IBP forecast by brand and at the stock keeping unit (SKU) level. You will coordinate, challenge and influence building block with input from sales, marketing and other partners. In addition, you will review the disaggregated short-term demand plan, which includes SKU/location mix and weekly pacing. Finally, you will provide the finalized detailed demand plan by SKU to supply planners and adjust it based on feedback from supply planners or commercial teams.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Contribute to the demand management cycle of the integrated business planning (IBP) process for your categories and to strategy and structure discussions
* Liaise with the commercial and operational teams and develop ways to continuously improve communication between the functions to support the delivery of the business KPIs for their families
* Manage forecast compilation process, which includes owning the short-term weekly plan and the long-term forecast (three or more months)
* Interact with modelling team to generate statistical forecasting
* Participate in the integrated business planning process and manage the demand planning tool
* Perform root-cause analysis for continuous plan improvement for key service issues, forecast error and bias, and share output with appropriate leadership

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Experience in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment, preferably in food or other fast moving, dynamic industry where shelf life is a constraint
* Experience within an IBP/S&OP environment
* Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on priorities and improving the plan
* Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills – and able to understand and interpret data
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Team player who can work with many other functions on a daily basis

**More about this role**

**What you need to know about this position:**

You will be an integral part of the implementation and go-live of the new planning solution (o9) within the AMEA region, with a primary focus on executing Integration Testing (I Test), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and end-user training. You will work closely with the BU Champion and regional SME leads to ensure the solution is thoroughly tested, validated, and ready for business adoption. Meanwhile, as an early foundation of demand analysis role, this role would require business insights to deep dive into forecast error reasons and improve the AIML/Operation fcst KPI with BU team.

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**

* Solid understanding of Demand Planning processes (statistical forecasting, consensus planning, demand sensing)
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role
* Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity.
* Strong attention to detail — ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies
* Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects
* Good communication skills — ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines
* Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment
* Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus

**Education / Certifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or postgraduate. With relevant Demand planning experience.

**Job specific requirements:**

The Demand Planning SME will serve as the BU's dedicated testing and adoption resource for the o9 Demand Planning module. Reporting into the region DP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. The SME will act as the first line of support for end users, bridging the gap between the technical implementation team and the business, and championing user confidence and adoption of the new platform.

**Testing & Validation**

* Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Demand Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy
* Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams
* Perform security role validation — test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase
* Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases
* Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP
* Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks
* Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates

**Training & Change Adoption**

* Support the delivery of Pre-UAT and UAT training sessions for BU end users, including o9 system basics, Day-in-the-Life (DILO) walkthroughs, and advanced DP system training
* Conduct shadow testing sessions — walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence
* Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working
* Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance
* Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts

**Go-Live & Sustainment**

* Support Parallel Run execution — assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes
* Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation
* Provide hypercare support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues
* Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning
* Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform

**Demand Analysis Support**

* High data quality management before modelling run – co-work with market planner and stakeholder to set foundation of master data, transaction and driver data.
* Closely working with data scientists to maintain the highest degree of forecast at item and planning accounts level based on industry trends and demand patterns.
* Conduct forecast review and analysis to assess demand trends, measure forecast accuracy, recommend data-driven adjustments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product lifecycle milestones, ensuring accurate demand planning for new items.
* Propose and implement forecasting improvements to enhance demand accuracy and efficiency.
